description: Update an existing pipeline stage's name, default probability, or WIP limit. Provide the stage id (from list_pipeline_stages) and ONLY the fields to change — omitted fields keep their current value; wipLimit null removes the limit. A name cannot be blank and must be unique among stages (409 CONFLICT otherwise). Stages cannot be created here, and stage order and terminal behavior are fixed. The result echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The pipeline stage id returned by list_pipeline_stages.

patch.description: Pipeline stage fields to change: name, defaultProbability and/or wipLimit. Provide at least one; omitted fields are left as they are.

defaultProbability.description: Default win probability for deals in this stage, 0-100.

name.description: Display name of the pipeline stage.

wipLimit.description: Work-in-progress limit (max deals allowed in the stage). Null or omit for no limit.

name: configure_pipeline
title: Configure pipeline stage
